name: My Tycoon Farm
desc:
🧠 Welcome to My Tycoon Farm! 

💸 Build & Expand — Place droppers to rain down studs and grow your tycoon!
⚙️ Upgrade — Boost your droppers, speed, and production to make even more money.
💰 Earn — Your tycoon keeps generating studs even when you’re offline!
🌟 Unlock Rarities — Discover powerful droppers and crazy upgrades that multiply your income!

💻 All Devices — Works on PC, Mobile, Tablet & Console!
